# ![SkillEvaluator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/ad2815fe78c045db91d230681d32863698da08cf/docs/assets/skillevaluator-wordmark.svg)

Evaluate and improve AI agent skills and plugins: quality, security, overlap, compatibility, and real impact across agents

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.12%20%7C%203.13%20%7C%203.14-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/skillevaluator.svg?label=PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/skillevaluator/) [![Reusable CI templates](https://img.shields.io/badge/Reusable%20CI-templates-blue.svg)](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/repository-integration#copy-a-template) [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/Documentation-docs.nvidia.com-blue.svg)](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/) [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/arXiv-2608.20614-b31b1b.svg)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20614) [![Blog](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blog-NVIDIA%20Developer-76B900.svg)](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/evaluating-ai-agent-skill-performance-with-nvidia-skillevaluator/) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/forks)
> 📺 **Livestream:** [Ask the Experts: Evaluating Agent Skills](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4rI0zATFxYI) SkillEvaluator checks AI agent skills and plugins, and measures a skill's effect on task results: start with quality checks, then compare runs with and without a skill. Catch skill issues before merge. Connect your repository to SkillEvaluator with a [CI template](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/repository-integration#copy-a-template) for automated quality and security gates, without building or maintaining evaluation code. Agent skills are folders of instructions and supporting files defined by the [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/). SkillEvaluator is part of the [NVIDIA Verified Skills pipeline](https://github.com/NVIDIA/skills). ## Get started Install the CLI in a Python 3.12–3.14 environment: ```bash pip install skillevaluator ```
Or use uv ```bash uv tool install --python 3.13 skillevaluator ```
For uv setup or direct GitHub source installation, see [Installation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation). Then check skills from your terminal, CI, or agent:

Quickly check your skill without an LLM key: ```bash skillevaluator quality-check ./my-skill ``` After [all-tier setup with NVIDIA Build](#run-all-three-tiers-with-a-free-nvidia-build-key), run the combined pipeline: ```bash skillevaluator validate \ ./my-skill ```

Check every skill change. Run in your GitHub repo to open a setup PR: ```bash skillevaluator ci init ``` GitLab details: [repository guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/repository-integration).

Add the skill to Claude Code, Codex or another agent: ```bash npx skills add \ NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator ``` Then ask: *"Is my skill any good?"* See the [agent guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/agent-skill).
### ⚡ [Harness check](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/harness-check): will your agent load your skill? Included in SkillEvaluator 1.0.1; see [Installation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation) for package availability. No model key or agent run. ```bash skillevaluator harness-check ./my-skill ``` Illustrative summary of versioned profiles. Full output can include notes and schema diagnostics. ```text ╭─ Harness compatibility · my-skill ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ ⚠️ codex degraded Description cut to 1,021 chars + '...' in the skill list │ │ ❌ claude-code not loaded .agents/skills is not scanned │ │ ✅ opencode loads │ │ ✅ hermes loads │ │ ✅ openclaw loads │ │ ❌ copilot-cli not loaded description is 1,028 UTF-16 units, 4 over the 1,024 limit │ ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ❌ 2 of 6 not loaded ─╯ ``` `validate` in 1.0.1 includes it in Tier 1. 🧪 **Ready to go deeper?** Try a [live agent evaluation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/tier3-live-evaluation) (Tier 3). ## Quickstart ### Check your skill without a key ```bash skillevaluator quality-check ./my-skill ``` No API key, scanner, GPU or Docker is needed. It prints a score out of 100 with a grade and the findings behind it; the passing threshold defaults to 70. This is static quality only; publication evidence stays `INCOMPLETE`. Security and agent impact need additional checks. See the [keyless walkthrough](docs/quickstart.mdx#run-without-an-llm). No skill yet? Clone the repository and use the bundled `src/skillevaluator/tier3/reference_skills/text-analyzer`. Scores can differ by release. ### Run all three tiers with a free NVIDIA Build key Eligible NVIDIA Developer Program members can use NVIDIA-hosted endpoints for **free prototyping**, subject to [access terms and rate limits](https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/docs/product). 1. Sign in at [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com/) and complete enrollment. 2. Open a model page, select **Get API Key**, and generate your key. 3. Complete [scanner setup](docs/installation-options.mdx#system-tools), start Docker, and [prepare a reviewed dataset](docs/prepare-dataset.mdx). Install every tier, set the provider and key, then validate: ```bash pip install "skillevaluator[all]" export SKILL_EVAL_LLM_PROVIDER=nv_build export NVIDIA_API_KEY='nvapi-...' skillevaluator validate ./my-skill ``` Without `--tiers`, `validate` runs all three. The key covers embeddings and chat in Tier 2 and supported agents in Tier 3; add `--llm` for model checks in Tier 1. For uv or GitHub installations, use the matching [all-tier install](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation#all-tiers) instead of the pip command above. Tier 3 also needs Docker running; add `--tiers 1,2` to skip it. More in [Run the combined pipeline](#run-the-combined-pipeline), the [Build walkthrough](docs/quickstart.mdx#use-nvidia-build) and [provider configuration](docs/configuration.mdx). ## Three-tier overview ![Three-tier pipeline: skill, validation, deduplication, live evaluation, reports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/ad2815fe78c045db91d230681d32863698da08cf/docs/assets/three-tier-overview.svg) Each tier is independent. Use the [all-tier installation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation#all-tiers) for all three: | Tier | Question | Example after setup | Additional setup | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Tier 1: Validation | Is the skill safe, well-formed and [harness-compatible](docs/tier1-reference.mdx#the-checks)? | `skillevaluator tier1 ./my-skill --no-llm` | External scanners for full static coverage; a provider and model clients enable LLM checks | | Tier 1: Harness Check | Will the agent load the skill? | `skillevaluator harness-check ./my-skill` | SkillEvaluator 1.0.1; no API key or agent run | | Tier 2: Deduplication | Does guidance repeat or overlap? | `skillevaluator tier2 ./my-skill` | Embeddings and chat; add `--catalog ./skill-catalog.json` for inter-skill comparison | | Tier 3: Live Agent Evaluation | Does the skill help the agent? | `skillevaluator tier3 ./my-skill` | Provider access, a supported agent, and a running sandbox (Docker by default) | Prepare [scanners](docs/installation-options.mdx#system-tools) for your installed release; Semgrep is optional. `--no-llm` does not remove scanner requirements; a scanner that cannot run is `INCOMPLETE` and exits nonzero. [SkillSpector](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector) provides specialized skill security scanning; [Harbor](https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor), the open-source agent evaluation framework, powers sandboxed agent runs. Tier 2 reports when inter-skill comparison did not run. Tier 3 autopilot reuses sources or creates one skill-grounded case with limited coverage. See [tier guides](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/). ## Run the combined pipeline After setting up the provider, scanners, and agent sandbox, run all three tiers: ```bash skillevaluator doctor --env-mode docker skillevaluator validate ./my-skill ``` `doctor` checks readiness, not inference success. `validate` runs all tiers with autopilot for skills. Use `--tiers 1,2` to skip live evaluation or `--tiers 1` for static checks. `--no-autopilot` requires an existing source. Other artifact types retain their applicable stages. Tier 1 gates `validate`. Tier 2 gates unless `--no-block-on-dedup` is set; Tier 3 gates only with `--block-on-agent-eval`. Model and managed-sandbox usage can incur charges; see [runtime and cost](docs/tier3-run-reference.mdx#plan-for-cost). Standalone generation needs substantive `evals/EVAL.md` guidance, a `--prompt` file with task requests and outcomes, or matching retained traces. `--force` below replaces the autopilot starter; `--refine` refines it. Explicit `--grounding skill` permits skill-only starters. Review cases; templates omit unauthored negatives. ```bash skillevaluator tier3 create-eval-dataset ./my-skill --full --prompt eval-guidance.md --force ``` ## Run from a source checkout For an editable environment, follow the [development setup](docs/developer-guide.mdx#set-up-a-development-environment). ## Research and citation Resources: [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20614), [PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.20614), [DOI](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.20614), [BibTeX](https://arxiv.org/bibtex/2608.20614), and [NVIDIA Developer blog](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/evaluating-ai-agent-skill-performance-with-nvidia-skillevaluator/). Cite the paper and record the SkillEvaluator release or commit; see [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff). ## Documentation See [the documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/) for setup, tier guides, reports, CI integration, CLI reference, and [performance dashboard](docs/reports.mdx#performance-dashboard). ## Installation and third-party software This project will download and install additional third-party open source software projects. Review the license terms of these open source projects before use. ## Contributing Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and run: ```bash make lint && make test && make build ``` See [project governance](GOVERNANCE.md) and [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). ## Support Support level: **Experimental**. Community-supported, best-effort, with no SLA or NVIDIA enterprise support entitlement. Report bugs and feature requests through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/issues); see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md). ## Security Report suspected vulnerabilities using the private process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not disclose security issues in a public GitHub issue. ## Releases See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) and [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/releases). ## License Apache License 2.0: see [LICENSE](LICENSE), [NOTICE](NOTICE), and [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
